    IFNULL(cast(replace(cast(to_date(work_lot.est_works_completion, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as string), '-', '') as int), -1)
 as estimated_completion_date,
    
    IFNULL(cast(replace(cast(to_date(work_lot.initial_date_closed, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as string), '-', '') as int), -1)
 as initial_closed_date,
    
    IFNULL(cast(replace(cast(to_date(work_lot.date_submitted, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as string), '-', '') as int), -1)
 as compliance_submitted_date,
    
    IFNULL(cast(replace(cast(to_date(work_lot.date_closed, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as string), '-', '') as int), -1)

    IFNULL(cast(replace(cast(to_date(work_lot.actual_works_completion, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as string), '-', '') as int), -1)

    ifnull(status.value,'Missing') as status,
    work_lot.iv_reference_no as iv_reference_no,
    
    IFNULL(cast(replace(cast(to_date(work_lot.iv_date_reviewed, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as string), '-', '') as int), -1)
 as iv_reviewed_date,
    iv_status.description as iv_status,
    work_lot.alternate_reference_number,
    control_line.description as control_line,
    project_lot_status.description as project_lot_status,
    work_lot.compliance_comment,
    project_activities.project_activity_list,
    'testing' as testing
from `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`work_lot_item_latest` work_lot
-- Administration
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`work_lot_admin_latest` wla
    on wla.id = work_lot.admin_id
-- Project
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`dim_project` project
    on project.src_project_code = wla.project_id
    and project.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
-- Type
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` type 
    on work_lot.work_lot_type_id=type.id
-- IV status
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` iv_status 
    on work_lot.iv_status_id=iv_status.id
-- Regions
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`item_wbs_data_latest` wbs 
    on wbs.id = work_lot.item_wbs_data_id
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`ref_region` region 
    on region.src_region_code = wbs.region_id
    and region.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`ref_region` main_area
    on main_area.src_region_code = wbs.main_area_id
    and main_area.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`ref_region` sub_area
    on sub_area.src_region_code = wbs.sub_area_id
    and sub_area.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
-- Client Review
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` layer
    on layer.id = work_lot.layer_name_id
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` lane
    on lane.id = work_lot.lane_name_id
-- Contacts
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`dim_contact` engineer
    on engineer.src_contact_code = work_lot.responsible_engineer_id
    and engineer.src_table = 'pp.project_contact'
    and engineer.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`dim_contact` entry
    on entry.src_contact_code = work_lot.entered_by_id
    and entry.src_table = 'pp.contact'
    and entry.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`dim_contact` submission
    on submission.src_contact_code = work_lot.submitted_by_id
    and submission.src_table = 'pp.contact'
    and submission.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
left join `lwynne_dev`.`silver`.`dim_contact` closure
    on closure.src_contact_code = work_lot.closed_by_id
    and closure.src_table = 'pp.contact'
    and closure.audit_active_ind = 'Y'
-- Activity
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` activity
    on activity.id = work_lot.activity_code
    -- status
left join  `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`lookup_latest` status
    on status.id = Work_lot.status_id
-- Link
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_dbo`.`link_url_latest` link
    on 1=1
    and link.whse_deleted = 'NaT'
    and system_name = 'PPW' 
    and model_name = 'PPW Work Lot'
    and table_name = 'Worklot'
-- Control Line
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` control_line
    on control_line.id = work_lot.control_line_id
-- Project Lot Status
left join `lwynne_dev`.`bronze_pp`.`reference_data_latest` project_lot_status
    on project_lot_status.id = work_lot.project_lot_status_id
    -- Project Activities
left join project_activities
    on project_activities.src_work_lot_code = work_lot.id
